title: W021.5 Source Acquisition Register — Resumption R1
retrievalMethod: Web discovery plus repository connector review. A discovered page is not equivalent to a downloaded, hashed source artifact. Additional official TGRAC service discovery and raw-geometry probe executed 2026-10-26 through a read-only GitHub Actions workflow. Expanded TGRAC service-family probe completed 2026-10-26; duplicate/near-duplicate candidate responses are recorded separately and not counted as independent corroboration. Legal source acquisition run 40260777545 acquired and hashed the APSeeds-hosted AP Reorganisation Act copy and two official PIB HTML variants; the exact ECI 2018 notification returned HTTP 406 and the CEO/ECI PDFs timed out. Hashes are assigned only to actual source bytes, never to error pages as if they were documents. Reproducible TGRAC family comparison run 40261390903 succeeded: 8 candidate layers, 28 pairwise comparisons, 3 duplicate raw-response groups; generated report variant_comparison.json SHA-256 76b1565e7b2308c3e4fe1288a7ed198d05d35e65aa8566ddb67d8bcd7ff6bc35 inside artifact ZIP SHA-256 a2752bb4906e33d826fe4e5ce4292c1d46ea5a0f32172937d34c91893ecea3ee. Supplemental discovery sweep on 2026-10-26 reviewed the ECI publications index, ECI delimitation landing page, IndiaCode-hosted 2008 order URL, India Geodata candidate index and NIC admin2024 GIS metadata. These are recorded as discovery-only unless raw source bytes were actually acquired; no hashes or byte sizes are claimed for page-only leads. Direct IndiaCode download attempt in this session failed; exact URL is queued for a controlled read-only retry.

rules.hashPolicy: SHA-256 must be computed over exact downloaded bytes; never use a Git blob SHA as a file SHA-256.
rules.authorityPolicy: Government sources are primary only for the specific subject they publish. Community GIS is candidate/secondary data until reconciled to primary source.
rules.missingDataPolicy: Missing values remain NULL/UNKNOWN; no fabricated election result, geometry, PIN crosswalk, or financial disclosure.

The official ECI 2008 PDF binary endpoint returned HTTP 406 (1,035-byte error body, SHA-256 7f512a...); web PDF text was reviewed, but no PDF binary hash is claimed.

The older AdministrativeInfoSystem layer is the outlier with six material AC geometry shifts. Prefer the newer family for legal validation, not canonical import.
